title: lootframe
summary: MSUI's loot window is a close counterpart of Benilla's: Program.Loot.cs draws the 256x256 UI-LootPanel slab at the left UIPanel seat with the TargetDead skull through the portrait ring, quality-colored rows with icon + UI-QuestItemNameFrame parchment plate + stack counts, a synthesized coin row (denomination icon + 'X Gold Y Silver' text), the 4-rows/3+pager paging law with ChatFrame scroll-arrow pager buttons, minimize-style close, row hover highlight + shared item tooltip, click-to-loot (CMSG_AUTOSTORE_LOOT_ITEM / CMSG_LOOT_MONEY), autoloot, and client-authoritative auto-release on movement/despawn. Registry shows 25/25 opcodes hit.

openItems.text: No loot-window sounds (reference LootFrame_OnShow plays per-loot-type open kits, e.g. LOOTWINDOWOPENEMPTY); Program.Loot.cs has no PlaySound calls
Skull overlay is static corpse art only - fishing loot icon swap not modeled (same reduction Benilla notes for itself)
